import { resolveComponent as _resolveComponent, createVNode as _createVNode, openBlock as _openBlock, createElementBlock as _createElementBlock, unref as _unref } from "vue"


export default {
  __name: 'Layout',
  props: {
    myIcon: { type: null, required: true },
    icon: { type: null, required: true }
  },
  setup(__props) {


return (_ctx, _cache) => {
  const _component_Icon = _resolveComponent("Icon")

  return (_openBlock(), _createElementBlock("div", null, [
    _createVNode(_unref(__props["myIcon"])),
    _createVNode(_component_Icon)
  ]))
}
}

}
